title: Search - make term/prefix/wildcard/regex query parsing more lenient

timeline.body:
Remove errors when case_insensitive flag set to false
Closes #63893
What's the plan here?  To allow clients to set `caseInsensitive` to `false`?

reply.body: Yep. Makes some of the clients easier to write
